name: Hill
terrainPostRollNote: Hill Close Combat cap is derived from relative position: uphill max 2; downhill or hill-to-hill max 3 for foot and max 2 for mounted. Hill does not add a ranged dice cap.

name: Forest
terrainPostRollNote: Forest blocks line of sight. Command cards that add dice modify the terrain maximum.

name: Broken Ground
terrainPostRollNote: Broken Ground does not affect Ranged Combat dice. Command cards that add dice modify the Close Combat maximum.

name: Fordable River
terrainPostRollNote: Fordable River does not block line of sight. A unit may still Momentum Advance after successful Close Combat.

name: River
terrainPostRollNote: River hexes are normally impassable unless scenario rules specify otherwise.

name: Rampart
terrainPostRollNote: Rampart protection applies only through protected forward hexsides: disregard one sword and one flag in Close Combat, or one flag from Ranged Combat. Mounted units receive no rampart protection.

name: Fortified Camp
terrainPostRollNote: Defending foot units on Fortified Camp disregard one sword and may disregard one flag in Close Combat, or one flag from Ranged Combat. Mounted units receive no protective benefit.

name: Seacoast
terrainPostRollNote: Seacoast is impassable and does not block line of sight.
